Title: Aarav's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 36 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The garden - Day

[Aarav stands in the garden. Sunita stands near him.]

Aarav: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav waters the plants.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

[Aarav chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Aarav: "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[Aarav searches for his lost ball.]

Aarav: "Okay, Mom."

[Aarav dances to the music.]

Aarav (laughing): "That's great!"

[Aarav points at the sky.]

Aarav (happily): "Let's see."

[Aarav shouts angrily.]

Aarav: "Yes, all right."

[Aarav bursts out laughing.]

Aarav: "Mom, listen!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Aarav: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aarav trips over a stone and falls.]

Sunita: "What a day to remember!"
